GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok sat 3l off, ridden along turn, Straightened Up 2-3l off all clear, battled on strong to the line , just no match leader/winner # found 1 better
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Got its head up and over-raced in the early and middle stages

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow Out 1 1/2 Lengths Not Bustled Settled Down Off Mid-Field Inside 8 Lengths following 1st x 2 Lengths , into Clear @ 400m immed popped the question, kept on okay to 100m then couldn't finish off - # found wanting late
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Slow to begin. Over the final 50m had to be steadied when racing tight.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow Out 1 Lengths Settled Down 6th/7th 5 Lengths off leader/winner Ridden Along Turning for home clear run home Inside kept trying without threatening - # tardy, Held Ground
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly. Approaching the 600m was steadied.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Bit Slow Out 1 length sat last 4l off, much the same turn, Straightened Up 4l off, running on took over 100m and drew clear # ran on from last
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Slow to begin. When questioned re improved performance, tnr rep stated the win came as some surprise to the stable however the horse had obviously reacted well to the removal of blinkers which allowed it to race more tractably and close off well.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok sat 3l off, pushed along a touch turn, Straightened Up 2-3l off, found little and dropped out # weak run home
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Shifted out on jumping and bumped. Raced fiercely through the early stages and near the 1100m got its head up, shifted in and became unbalanced after making contact with another runner. Continued to race keenly through the middle stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Bit Slow Out settled near last 5l off, saved ground turn, Straightened Up 4l off, kept on one pace # back/no threat
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: From an outside barrier was shifted behind runners in the early stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Well , Went Forward then Eased 3rd Inside 2 Lengths @ 1000m. Ridden Along Straightening Up , Couldn'T Go On at all Not Knocked About last 125 # weak to finish
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rdr reported in her view the gelding did not appreciate racing on the Good (4) surface and would be better suited to a track with more give. A post-race vet exam revealed no abnormalities.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow Out 1 Lengths Straight Out The Back Settled Down 8th Inside 8 Lengths Nowhere To Go Until Straightening Up bumped Kept Trying - 1st sat 2nd 1st 2 out 1st 2 home - # Need To See Again
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: On the home turn momentarily raced tight.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Little Slow Out Ridden Along Settled Down 4th Inside 4 Lengths eased off heels and 5th x 500m, off Inside @ 400m Took over x 100m, # simply too good

Slow out 1.5 Lengths and Settled Down last 8 Lengths from the lead, railed up to 4 Lengths turning, Held Up home turn then Hooked Out widest in Straight and Made Ground down the outside rail in Straight # slow out/ok late
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Slow to begin. Held up rounding the home turn before being shifted to the outside of runners passing the 400m to obtain clear running.
